research_question: Can validation-selected selective routing from the strict TF-IDF plus aspect-conditioned sentiment endpoint to the active frozen candidate-pair Qwen endpoint improve pair F1 under a 50 percent mean Qwen-call budget?

scope.primary_metric: unweighted mean of fold-level pair micro-F1

local.vocabulary_fitting: permitted training reviews only; candidate text excluded
local.threshold: per-method per-target-aspect validation pair micro-F1 threshold frozen by loao_similarity_aspect_conditioned_sentiment_rescore_v1

qwen.threshold: per-target-aspect validation pair micro-F1 threshold frozen by the candidate-pair experiment

strict_alignment: exact one-to-one row_uid set, deterministically joined in strict TF-IDF artifact order

definition.local_absent: use Qwen when threshold minus local presence score is at or below the fold cutoff for rescue_fraction
definition.local_present: use Qwen when local presence score minus threshold is at or below the fold cutoff for confirm_fraction
definition.otherwise: use strict TF-IDF presence plus aspect-conditioned sentiment

policy_search.fold_cutoff_rule: For each side independently, take the validation distance at rank ceil(fraction * eligible_rows), using stable ascending distance and row_uid order; a zero fraction disables that side.
policy_search.selection_scope: one fraction pair selected globally from all twelve validation folds

paired_diagnostics: fold-resampling bootstrap 95 percent interval with seed 20260723

admission_gate.decision_if_passed: retain as a supporting deployment method, separate from the baseline table
admission_gate.decision_if_failed: report as a negative optional experiment and omit a thesis quality-call-rate figure

limitations: This is post-hoc relative to already observed endpoint test results, although the replacement router policy and gate are registered before its execution.
Target-aspect validation labels calibrate both endpoints and router policy, so this is not strict zero-label LOAO.
The twelve folds share underlying reviews and are not independent datasets.
